as_told.title: Immaculate Constellation revealed at congressional hearings

tellings.quote: these individuals have revealed the name of an active and highly secretive DoD unacknowledged special access program, or USAP.

plain: In late 2024, hearings on Capitol Hill brought out the name of a secret Pentagon programme said to deal with UAP, the official term for UFOs: Immaculate Constellation. Michels describes it on one episode as a revelation from hearings in Congress and then, that same week, in the Senate. On another he simply calls it a top-secret programme. The source is a public document of record: the House Committee on Oversight and Accountability hearing "Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena: Exposing the Truth", held on 13 November 2024. In his written statement for it, the journalist Michael Shellenberger says his sources "have revealed the name of an active and highly secretive DoD unacknowledged special access program, or USAP". A USAP is a secret Pentagon programme whose very existence is officially denied. Michels and Shellenberger raise it because, if it is real, the Pentagon would be running a hidden UAP effort that Congress was never told about.
